figure2.bound_semantics: Nonstatistical conservative graphical reading bound including curve thickness and axis calibration; not a measurement sigma.
figure2.reading_method: Visually inspected source raster. Median grayscale over three adjacent columns, threshold 70; curve-center y is mean of each contiguous dark run. Column 780 avoids markers and labels. Axis endpoints/ticks read independently.

source_notation_cold_reference_gamma_n7.scope: Implicit equation with gamma/theta evaluated at BM3 V(P,300); denominator remains actual molar V. Not adopted.

all_85.objective: equal pressure residuals; high-pressure data only
all_85.uncertainty: RSS/dof-scaled local covariance; no calibration, fixed-input, predictor or shared-data covariance

heated_74.objective: equal pressure residuals; high-pressure data only
heated_74.uncertainty: RSS/dof-scaled local covariance; no calibration, fixed-input, predictor or shared-data covariance

normalization_fingerprint.note: One scalar projection at unchanged published coefficients. Not a physical atom count, recovered author setting, correction or registered refit.

later_author_code_crosscheck.evaluation: Literal Python translation of pressure/energy formulas; MATLAB program not executed
later_author_code_crosscheck.coefficient_target: 2009 wadsleyite coefficients, not the different 2022 fit vector

n7.note: Exploratory cross-model comparison only: the reported expansivity is associated with the separate HTBM fit, so exact agreement with MGD is not required and this is not a decisive MGD benchmark.

n5.note: Exploratory cross-model comparison only: the reported expansivity is associated with the separate HTBM fit, so exact agreement with MGD is not required and this is not a decisive MGD benchmark.

pressure_calibration.basis: Inherited from the explicitly cited Katsura (2004) procedure, corroborated by the cited 2009 forsterite method; not independently stated in the short 2009 wadsleyite text.
pressure_calibration.limitation: No original MgO cells, detailed reducer settings or run identities recovered. Model-inverted cells would not be independent calibration observations.

missing_original_fit_inputs: Inoue (2004) ambient expansion observations and their selection/normalization
Original weights, objective, covariance and fit session
Numeric author atom/mole normalization and precise evaluation prescription
Measured paired MgO cells and exact calibration reducer
disposition: Completed audit: source thermal-model/normalization consistency discrepancy is demonstrated; calibration alone cannot reconcile coefficients with the paper's own curves. Exact author-side cause unresolved. Keep the existing deferred hold and do not adopt n=5 or replace source coefficients.
